data.name: Bonus Feat
data.description: A tetori gains the following bonus feats - 1st level-Improved Grapple, 2nd level-Stunning Pin, 6th level-Greater Grapple, 10th level-Pinning Knockout, 14th level-Choke Hold, 18th level-Neckbreaker. These feats replace a monk's normal bonus feats.
